# Steel Craft Prefab

> Steel Craft designs and builds steel-framed prefab homes, modular villas and resort cottages, factory-finished and delivered across India.

Steel Craft Prefab builds steel-framed structures in the factory while the plot is prepared, which shortens build time. Layouts, glazing and finishes can be customised. Typical uses are homes, farmhouses, villas and resort cottages.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://www.steelcraftprefab.com/): Overview of Steel Craft prefab homes, modular technology and services
- [Projects](https://www.steelcraftprefab.com/projects): Completed prefab homes, villas and cottage projects
- [Homes & Cottages](https://www.steelcraftprefab.com/homes-cottages): Prefab home and resort cottage range
- [Contact](https://www.steelcraftprefab.com/contact): Request a quote or free consultation
